Cleanser.am: Wakes skin up and cleans off overnight oils.
Cleanser.pm: Removes pollution and sunscreen before skincare goes on.

reasons.Toner: Preps damp skin so your serums can go on smoothly.
reasons.Essence: Lightweight hydration that sinks in before treatment.
reasons.Treatment: Targeted active for blemishes, texture, or spot renewal.
reasons.Serum: Targeted actives soak in while the formula is thin.
reasons.Eye cream: Thinner skin around the eyes absorbs gently before heavier creams.
reasons.Moisturizer: Locks in hydration and cushions your skin barrier.
reasons.Facial oil: Nourishing plant oils seal your night routine.
reasons.Sunscreen: Sunscreen is always last. Never put moisturizer on top of sunscreen.
reasons.Serum.alt: Cell turnover active. Take turns on alternate nights.

conflicts.warning: Don't use on the same night. Take turns: one night each, never together.

ingredientNotes.retinol: Vitamin A active that encourages skin renewal.
ingredientNotes.encapsulated retinol: Vitamin A active that encourages skin renewal.

ingredientNotes.shea butter unsaponifiables: Rich plant butter that softens dry patches.

ingredientNotes.cetyl alcohol: A fatty alcohol that thickens creams. It isn't the drying kind of alcohol.
ingredientNotes.stearyl alcohol: A fatty alcohol that thickens creams. It isn't the drying kind of alcohol.

ingredientNotes.caprylyl glycol: Adds a little moisture and helps preserve the formula.

ingredientNotes.xanthan gum: A thickener that keeps the formula from separating.
ingredientNotes.carbomer: A thickener that gives gels and creams their body.

ingredientNotes.panthenol: Vitamin B5. Helps skin hold moisture and feel softer.
ingredientNotes.urea: Draws in water and gently loosens dry, rough skin.

ingredientNotes.stearic acid: A fatty acid that softens skin and thickens the formula.
ingredientNotes.oleic acid: A fatty acid that softens skin and thickens the formula.

ingredientNotes.homosalate: A chemical sun filter that absorbs UVB rays.

ingredientNotes.titanium dioxide: A mineral sun filter that sits on top of skin and reflects UV.

generalDoes.Cleanser: Washes off the day, or the night, so everything after it can do its job.
generalDoes.Toner: A light step after cleansing that preps your skin for what comes next.
generalDoes.Essence: A thin, watery layer that adds a little moisture before your serum.
generalDoes.Treatment: A targeted step for one specific concern. Go slow and watch how your skin feels.
generalDoes.Serum: A concentrated step that goes on before your moisturizer.
generalDoes.Eye cream: A gentle moisturizer made for the thin skin around your eyes.
generalDoes.Moisturizer: Helps hold moisture in and keeps your skin comfortable.
generalDoes.Facial oil: Helps seal in moisture. Usually goes on last at night.
generalDoes.Sunscreen: Protects your skin from the sun. Goes on last in the morning.
generalDoes.Mask: A once-in-a-while step. Follow the directions on the box.
generalDoes.Other: Something on your shelf that doesn't fit the usual steps.
